description: Per-instance and per-engine drill-down: load balance, latency outliers, scheduler behaviour, API server process and configuration.

panels.title: Instances (last 5 minutes)
panels.description: Current load and latency of every instance. Click an instance to focus the dashboard on it. *Uptime* comes from the API server's process metrics, which are not exported with `--api-server-count` > 1.

targets.expr: count by (model_name, instance) (vllm:num_requests_running{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
sum by (model_name, instance) (vllm:num_requests_running{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
sum by (model_name, instance) (vllm:num_requests_waiting{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
max by (model_name, instance) (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})
sum by (model_name, instance) (rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[5m]))
sum by (model_name, instance) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[5m]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name, instance) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name, instance) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[5m])))
sum by (model_name, instance) (rate(vllm:num_preemptions_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[5m]))

max by (model_name, instance) ((time() - process_start_time_seconds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) * on (job, instance) group_left (model_name) group by (job, instance, model_name) (vllm:num_requests_running{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}))

panels.title: Running requests
panels.description:
Requests in each engine's running batch.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_running`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (vllm:num_requests_running{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Waiting requests
panels.description:
Requests queued on each engine.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_waiting`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (vllm:num_requests_waiting{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: KV cache usage
panels.description:
GPU KV cache usage of each engine.

Metric: `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc`

targets.expr: max by (instance, engine) (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description:
Requests finished per second by each instance. Uneven values point at load balancing problems.

Metric: `vllm:request_success_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Input tokens / s
panels.description:
Prompt tokens per second on each engine.

Metric: `vllm:prompt_tokens_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:prompt_tokens_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Output tokens / s
panels.description:
Generated tokens per second on each engine.

Metric: `vllm:generation_tokens_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:generation_tokens_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description:
95th percentile time to first token on each instance.

Metric: `vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Inter-token latency p95
panels.description:
95th percentile inter-token latency on each instance.

Metric: `vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: E2E latency p95
panels.description:
95th percentile end-to-end request latency on each instance.

Metric: `vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds`

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, instance) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Mean queue time
panels.description:
Mean time requests wait before being scheduled on each instance.

Metric: `vllm:request_queue_time_seconds`

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (instance) (rate(vllm:request_queue_time_seconds_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Engine steps / s
panels.description:
Scheduler iterations per second.

Metric: `vllm:iteration_tokens_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:iteration_tokens_total_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Mean tokens per engine step
panels.description:
Mean prefill + decode tokens per step, a proxy for batch size.

Metric: `vllm:iteration_tokens_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:iteration_tokens_total_sum{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:iteration_tokens_total_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Preemptions / s
panels.description:
Requests preempted per second on each engine.

Metric: `vllm:num_preemptions_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:num_preemptions_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Waiting requests by reason
panels.description:
*capacity*: waiting for KV cache or batch capacity. *deferred*: held back by a transient constraint such as the LoRA budget or a pending KV transfer.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine, reason) (vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"})

panels.title: Prefix cache hit rate
panels.description:
Share of prompt tokens found in each engine's prefix cache.

Metrics: `vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total`, `vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) / (sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description:
CPU cores used by the API server process (tokenization, detokenization, request handling). Engine core and GPU worker processes are not included. Not exported with `--api-server-count` > 1.

Metric: `process_cpu_seconds_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Resident memory
panels.description:
Resident memory of the API server process.

Metric: `process_resident_memory_bytes`

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (process_resident_memory_bytes{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Open file descriptors
panels.description:
Open file descriptors as a share of the process limit. Each client connection holds one.

Metrics: `process_open_fds`, `process_max_fds`

targets.expr: sum by (instance) (process_open_fds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}) / sum by (instance) (process_max_fds{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Cache configuration
panels.description: KV cache settings of each engine, from the `vllm:cache_config_info` info metric.

targets.expr: vllm:cache_config_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}

panels.title: LoRA adapters
panels.description:
Adapters in the running and waiting batches, and the configured `--max-loras`, as last reported by each instance. Only exported when LoRA is enabled.

Metric: `vllm:lora_requests_info`

targets.expr: topk by (job, instance) (1, vllm:lora_requests_info{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Engine sleep state
panels.description:
Whether each engine is awake or put to sleep through the sleep mode API. Level 1 offloads the weights to CPU memory; level 2 discards them.

Metric: `vllm:engine_sleep_state`

targets.expr: (1 - max by (instance, engine) (vllm:engine_sleep_state{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", sleep_state="awake"})) * (1 + max by (instance, engine) (vllm:engine_sleep_state{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine", sleep_state="discard_all"}))

panels.title: Sleep mode and weight update operations (selected time range)
panels.description:
Sleep, wake and KV cache release calls of the sleep mode API, and weight transfer steps of RL weight updates, with their duration. Rows appear once an operation has run.

Metrics: `vllm:sleep_mode_operation_duration_seconds`, `vllm:rl_weight_update_operation_duration_seconds`

targets.expr: round(sum by (operation) (increase(vllm:sleep_mode_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) or round(sum by (operation) (increase(vllm:rl_weight_update_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

sum by (operation) (rate(vllm:sleep_mode_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / (sum by (operation) (rate(vllm:sleep_mode_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0) or sum by (operation) (rate(vllm:rl_weight_update_operation_duration_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / (sum by (operation) (rate(vllm:rl_weight_update_operation_duration_seconds_count{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, operation) (rate(vllm:sleep_mode_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) or histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, operation) (rate(vllm:rl_weight_update_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

panels.title: Estimated compute per GPU
panels.description:
Estimated floating point operations per second on each GPU. Divide by the GPU's peak dense FLOP/s for MFU.

Metric: `vllm:estimated_flops_per_gpu_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:estimated_flops_per_gpu_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Estimated memory traffic per GPU
panels.description:
Estimated bytes read from and written to GPU memory per second. Divide by the GPU's peak memory bandwidth for utilization.

Metrics: `vllm:estimated_read_bytes_per_gpu_total`, `vllm:estimated_write_bytes_per_gpu_total`

targets.expr: sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:estimated_read_bytes_per_gpu_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (instance, engine) (rate(vllm:estimated_write_bytes_per_gpu_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", engine=~"$engine"}[$__rate_interval]))

title: vLLM / Instances
